label: owns
definition: Argument 1 owns or previously owned company, organization or asset 2.
scope_notes: Owner/parent, completed acquisitions and explicit partial ownership qualify in owner-to-asset direction. Managing, publishing, proposing/rejecting a merger and political office alone do not.

facts.reason: News Corporation explicitly owns Fox and is its parent.
General Electric explicitly owns NBC and is its owner/parent.
General Electric Company explicitly owns NBC, which also appears as its unit/subsidiary.
Kalikow is explicitly owner of The New York Post, with own/acquire paths beyond the publisher title.
William spends time in Manhattan in the sole row; no ownership of an organization or asset is expressed.
